name: cited-list
title: Cited List
description: An answer as numbered points, each a sentence followed by its sources as small muted chips — links by default, or any element through render (a router link, a play-from-here button).

meta.whenToUse: An AI or search answer whose points each cite where they came from: a summary, an Ask answer, a list of findings.
meta.whenNotToUse: A mention or file link inside running text (InlineChip), a tool invocation in a transcript (ToolCallChip), or a plain numbered list with no sources.
